title: The Eagle and the Kite

full_text:
A kite wooed an eagle maiden, boasting that he was powerful enough to seize and carry off a full-grown ostrich in his talons. The eagle, impressed by his mighty claims, accepted him as her mate.

After the wedding, she asked him to demonstrate his boast by catching the promised ostrich.

The kite soared high and returned clutching an ancient, rotten field mouse!

"Is this your ostrich?" asked the indignant eagle.

The kite replied: "To win so noble a prize as your hand, my love, I would have promised to capture the entire earth!"
moral: Those who make extravagant promises before marriage are often revealed as powerless afterward.
